Build is clean. `0 errors`, exit code 0.

Both real bugs were in the link stage, hidden under ~950 lines of harmless deprecation noise:

1. `src/core/options.js:7` — read `options.retries`, but the bumped bundler now passes `retryCount`. Fixed to read `retryCount`.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js:8` — threw on `undefined` flags instead of treating unset as `false`, but the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`. Fixed to treat anything not `true` as disabled.

The other 8 warnings (Buffer/punycode deprecations, circular import, unused export, etc.) are pre-existing noise, not bump-caused — left alone.

Next: run `node build.js` yourself to see the full clean log.
